title: Agent Loop with Three Safety Gates
description: Code-level safety rails for LLM agents: human checkpoint for irreversible actions, static analysis for generated code, and hard tool-call budget.

steps.description: Constants and counters: MAX_ITERATIONS=25, MAX_TOOL_CALLS=50, and tool_call_count initialized to 0.
Constants: easy to adjust per deployment, define maximum cycles and total tool calls.
Loop: for iteration in range(MAX_ITERATIONS) with three safety gates in sequence.
Safety gate 1: human checkpoint for irreversible actions like deleting files or sending emails.
Safety gate 2: static analysis via sandbox_validates for code execution actions, rejects bad code and continues.
Safety gate 3: tool-call budget enforced with running counter, returns budget_exceeded when exhausted.
Execution: sandbox.execute with 30-second timeout, failure added to context for agent reasoning.
